objective: One sentence: what must be true when the loop is done.
test_cmd: the FULL test command for the repo, e.g. npm test / pytest -q / go test ./...
regression_cmd: the PRE-EXISTING suite only (new tests excluded); must stay green every iteration. Empty string if same as test_cmd

metric.name: p95_ms
metric.cmd: command that prints the metric; the last number on stdout is used unless regex is set
